title: Investigating Implicit Bias in Large Language Models: A Large-Scale Study of Over 50 LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating implicit associations using the LLM Implicit Association Test (prompting the model to assign descriptive attributes to different racial/ethnic groups) and the LLM Decision Bias test (prompting the model to assign positive or negative scenarios to characters of different races).

Evaluating implicit associations using the LLM Implicit Association Test and the LLM Decision Bias test to measure biased associations regarding careers, science, power, and sexuality between different genders.

Evaluating implicit associations using the LLM Implicit Association Test and the LLM Decision Bias test on social attributes and scenarios related to disability, age, weight, body types, and mental illness.

Evaluating implicit associations using the LLM Implicit Association Test and the LLM Decision Bias test to measure biases toward different religious identities, including Islam, Judaism, and Buddhism.
